programme.desc: Encontrar un grupo de jóvenes cazadores es cada vez más habitual, lo que demuestra que la pasión por la caza no tiene edad ni límites.

programme.title: Hermanos Errantes T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Asistimos a una batida de alta montaña en pleno Valle de Arán, en el corazón de los Pirineos catalanes. Los anfitriones de nuestro equipo serán una cuadrilla o 'colha' local y veremos a sus perros laikas y 'osos de Carelia' en acción. Caza auténtica, natural y dura en un paraje impresionante.

programme.title: A Câmara T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Pesca submarina em Elantxobe Uma aventura emocionante que nos mergulha na excitante vida de Irkus, um pescador subaquático amador, uma viagem imersiva que combina a paixão pela pesca submarina com a riqueza cultural de Ea e Elantxobe, uma visão única da vida neste encantador recanto da costa da Biscaia.

programme.title: Quemado T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Lubinas E Raias, Projeto Move
programme.desc: En Asturias, la caza del jabalí con perros de rastro es una modalidad tradicional practicada por auténticos apasionados. En esta ocasión acompañamos a una cuadrilla que caza en varios lotes bañados por el rio Narcea, famoso por sus salmones.

programme.title: De Montería T9 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Se dice del markhor que es el más bello animal que puebla las cumbres asiáticas. Para muchos es el grial de la caza de montaña. En Tayikistán, desafiando escarpadas laderas y un clima adverso, intentamos conseguir uno de los más grandes trofeos de este exclusivo animal.

programme.title: Batidas Jabalineras A Orillas Del Narcea
programme.desc: Es joven, cazador y uno de nuestros cámaras más habituales en Caza y Pesca. Javier Martínez Urbano se sienta a charlar con Bea Rosete sobre la caza del siglo XXI, sobre los retos y las satisfacciones de documentar una jornada de caza y sobre las muchas anécdotas que surgen cuando hay una grabación implicada.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Alejandro, Diego e David são três amigos que pescam juntos alguns fins de semana e frequentam o Limia em Ourense. Um rio que tem muitas trutas, mas às vezes está um pouco cheio e isso dificulta a pesca. Também pescam no rio Deva, um rio de montanha, estreito e muito arborizado, com trutas pequenas mas divertidas.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: No nono episódio rumamos a Castelo Branco, a capital da Beira Baixa. A primeira proposta é uma reinvenção da sopa à lavrador com um toque especial de chef e com o famoso queijo de Castelo Branco. Na segunda receita temos um chambão de borrego com polenta cremosa. Uma viagem gastronómica muito especial.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Continuamos esta volta a Portugal explorando as melhores iguarias. O destino do episódio de hoje é Vila Real. A chef Marlene Vieira apresenta-nos duas propostas de pastéis: uma salgada e uma doce. Os primeiros são os famosos pastéis de chaves e os segundos são os pitos de Santa Luzia. Delicie-se com estas propostas.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A viagem pelas delícias gastronómicas do país continua com a Chef Marlene Vieira ao comando. O destino de hoje é Lisboa. E para homenagear a capital começamos com dois petiscos tradicionais fundidos num só prato: salada de favas com ovos verdes. Na segunda proposta temos uma Caldeirada de Peixe e Bivalves.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Dyer que procura um cão de assistência para o seu filho autista. Visitam o caniche standard, o goldendoodle e o collie, mas será que conseguem encontrar um animal de serviço que também seja de estimação?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Chretien que procura o cachorrinho ideal para criar uma ligação com o seu filho tímido, o Julian. Visitam o cockapoo, o labradoodle e o shichon. Cada membro da família tem o seu preferido, mas o Julian surpreende os seus pais com a sua decisão.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece Inji, uma mãe solteira que procura um cachorrinho para realizar o sonho da sua filha Yasmine. Visitam o Yorkshire terrier, o papillon e o bichon maltês, mas quando Yasmine gosta de todos, a decisão de Inji torna-se difícil.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Neste episódio, exploramos o potencial da pedra aliada à criatividade, com Carlos Vicente. Fátima Lopes vai ainda conhecer o calceteiro Jorge Loureiro, tão famoso pelas suas calçadas como pelas suas canções.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: As bonecas de pano fazem parte de uma tradição recuperada, em Lisboa, por Benedetta Maxia. Com Fátima Lopes, vamos conhecer as criações de Benedetta e viajamos ainda até Penha Garcia, para conhecer as tradicionais “Maias” de Adelaide Marques.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Chakall chamou a música e veio a Marisa Liz. Mas veio com uma exigência: um desafio vegetariano! As favas são o inimigo nº 1 desta convidada, mas para o chef será a segunda vez que terá de disfarçar este ingrediente tão temido.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Cortiça.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: João desvenda a lenda romana que ficou impressa na história de Ponte de Lima. Nas águas do rio, o nosso viajante acompanha uma das promessas da canoagem nacional e internacional e, junto à margem, descobre a musicalidade das concertinas em uníssono.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Da margem do Tejo, às Portas do Sol, João vai à descoberta de Santarém. O objetivo é sair da estrada e levantar pó, não sem antes experimentar a vida de um camponês barrão, conhecer um projeto de agricultura regenerativa e dar um pezinho no fandango.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Três chefs lançam-se às grelhas na Ronda Wildfire e servem uns pratos suculentos. Na Ronda Crossfire, os chefs precisam mesmo de encarnar a competição. A Ronda Feast of Fire é inspirada na dolce vita!.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O júri fica com uma espinha atravessada com os chefs na Ronda Wildfire. Não há caroço que não seja plantado enquanto os chefs se defrontam na Ronda Crossfire. O Feast of Fire traz-nos a comida beijada pelo fogo de Nova Orleães.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A tensão atiça-se rapidamente na Ronda Wildfire. Os chefs precisam de uma pitada de sal para terminar a Ronda Crossfire e a ronda final é sobre celebrar o Cabo.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Borrego assado e Salame de chocolate.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 16

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira traz duas receitas que nasceram no seu restaurante ZunZum e prometem conquistar muitas casas portuguesas: Bochechas de porco com batata doce e picadinho algarvio e Costeleta de sardinha panada com arroz de tomate.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Chocos guisados com batata doce” proposta pelo Mercado de Olhão e, depois, irá cozinhar “Sericaia”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado do Livramento de Setúbal.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Arroz de tamboril” proposta pelo Mercado de Alvalade em Lisboa e, depois, irá cozinhar “Lombo de porco no forno”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado de São João da Madeira.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: A família Harding está à procura de um cachorrinho a sério que seja mais divertido do que um peluche. Será que os dois irmãos vão conseguir decidir entre o galgo afegão, o golden doodle e o épagneul breton?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood visita a família McGrayne que procura um cachorrinho. Visitam bulldogs, beagles e Boston terriers, mas as coisas complicam-se, quando o filho mais novo, o Jackson, quer levar os cães todos para casa.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece o Mycal e a Amie, um casal que procura um cão que se enquadre no seu estilo de vida ativo. Enquanto visitam o dogue de Bordéus, o dogue alemão e o boxer, o Mycal mostra o seu lado sensível.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Com a Lua Azul a erguer-se no horizonte, João quer captar a fotografia perfeita. Mas em pleno Alentejo interior, João desvenda ainda os mistérios de 2 grandes navegadores, descobre uma praia entre sobreiros e aprende os segredos do vinho da talha.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Na cidade onde desagua o único rio português que corre de sul para norte, João precisa de vento para descobrir a vela. Mas antes, terá de lançar redes de pesca numa traineira, aprender a falar charroco e provar uma das iguarias desta região.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Conhecer as salinas, perceber como é feita a extração tradicional de sal e experimentar a vida de marnoto fazem parte desta aventura em Aveiro. Mas há mais! Entre o mar e a ria, o surf e a música, há milhares de ovos para partir.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Na Cidade do Cabo, Verónica descobre a diversidade sul-africana: prova koesister em Bo-Kaap e faz piquenique no Signal Hill. Aprende potjiekos em família, visita Khayelitsha e termina com um braai entre vinhas em Stellenbosch.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Em Barcelona, Verónica mergulha na tradição mediterrânea: percorre a cidade com Cristina Jolonch, vive uma calçotada, experimenta o “esmorzar de forquilla” e saboreia bacalhau à llauna. A viagem termina em Vic com o chef Nandu Jubany.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Em Berlim, Verónica celebra o 1º de maio e descobre sabores alemães: aprende a fazer spätzle, explora mercados ecológicos, cozinha pratos sazonais e prova currywurst. A aventura termina com café e a clássica torta Selva Negra.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Esta semana viajamos até Leiria. E vamos inspirar-nos em terras à beira-mar. A primeira proposta tem como inspiração Peniche e é uma tiborna de sardinha. No segundo prato viajamos até Vieira de Leiria onde o arroz de marisco é rei.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: O mapa de Portugal hoje leva-nos até ao distrito de Beja onde a gastronomia alentejana é rainha. Numa terra em que com pouco se faz muito, a chef Marlene Vieira apresenta-nos duas propostas. A primeira é uma costeleta com ameijoas e miga enrolada. A segunda proposta é Açorda de Bacalhau com grão.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Neste episódio viajamos até ao distrito de Setúbal. Numa terra de pescadores a primeira proposta da Chef Marlene Vieira é uma Feijoada de Choco com diferentes texturas. As famosas tortas de azeitão servem de inspiração para a segunda receita. Com os sabores da famosa iguaria a chef apresenta-nos um soufflé recheado com queijo de azeitão.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece as irmãs Boccanfuso que procuram um cachorrinho para tomar conta delas na escola. Visitam o West Highland terrier, o Wheaton terrier e o Airedale terrier, mas quando cada uma das irmãs gosta de um cão diferente, as coisas complicam-se.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família LaBarbera que procura um cão de grande porte para os seus quatro filhos. Visitam o pastor alemão, o husky siberiano e o braco alemão de pelo curto, mas será que o pai consegue encontrar o cachorrinho ideal para tomar conta da família?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Jensenque que está à procura de um companheiro para o cão da família, o Dexter. Visitam o linnois, o bernedoodle miniatura e o jarkie. Toda a gente tem o seu preferido, mas apenas um pode ser o novo amigo do Dexter.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes viaja até Loulé para conhecer Vanessa Flórido e as suas peças feitas com fibras naturais. A norte, irá ao encontro de Fátima Mendes e Carmo Cardoso, artesãs que mantêm viva a antiga tradição dos entrançados de palha de Fafe.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: A artista visual Ana Rita Arruda cria esculturas em lã, combinando um design moderno com várias técnicas de feltragem. Em Nisa, Fátima Lopes conhecerá Dinis Pereira, uma das últimas mestres a trabalhar o feltro segundo a tradição, nesta vila alentejana.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O jogo mudou e um dos ingredientes mais temidos desta temporada é o preferido de Diogo Beja. E agora que o Chef Chakall já está habituado a “esconder” esse ingrediente, como é que vai dar a volta ao desafio?.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Debra voltam a encontrar-se com antigos clientes para os ajudar a transformar uma garagem nunca usada numa fantástica casa de campo com dois quartos.

programme.title: Raízes - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nas Caldas da Rainha, o chef Vítor Adão visita a histórica praça da fruta, encontra-se com um ceramista e um cuteleiro e embarca à procura dos melhores ingredientes na Lagoa de Óbidos. O resultado é uma incrível caldeirada à moda antiga feita no fogo.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Lynne e o Mark compraram um chalé na esperança de que se tornasse num refúgio para relaxar. Mas após uma cheia, o sonho deles tornou-se numa série infindável de projetos DIY. Para que consigam ter rendimento para as obras, o Scott transforma este chalé do lago numa casa pet-friendly com comodidades para os membros da família de quatro patas.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Nas ruas do Porto, fachadas antigas ganham vida com os painéis vibrantes de Joana Abreu, inspirados em azulejos. Já em Anadia, encontramos Agostinho Duarte, que mantém viva a tradição azulejar portuguesa, dando vida a painéis pintados à mão.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes viaja até à oficina de Mircea Anghel, onde a madeira é transformada em peças inovadoras, como mesas que encarnam o conceito do equilíbrio instável. Vamos ainda conhecer o mestre de Mircea e carpinteiro naval Hélder Mateus.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Dedicamos este episódio ao aproveitamento caixas de madeira, grandes e pequenas, daquelas que são utilizadas para transportar alimentos. Se compraste morangos ou cerejas e tens algumas dessas caixas em casa, aproveita e inspira-te nos projetos da Joana.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-sena aventura deos restaurar e transformar em lares desonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Vera Kolodzig e Fátima Lopes rumam à Serra da Esperança para descobrir o TheVagar, um refúgio pensado para abrandar e reconectar com a natureza. Entre experiências únicas, este episódio é o convite ideal para fugir da rotina e recarregar energias.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A Tripeirinha junta-se a Vera Kolodzig para explorar o Craveiral Farmhouse, um refúgio alentejano em S. Teotónio. Numa escapadinha marcada pela simplicidade e sustentabilidade, descobrem um projeto que alia a vida no campo ao bem-estar.

programme.title: The Dog Academy T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Ghost, um “cachorrinho” cane corso de 50 kg, está a aterrorizar a vizinhança e os seus tutores. Embora as suas credenciais como cão de guarda sejam impecáveis, será que pode ser treinado para se adaptar à vida familiar? E será que vai deixar os treinadores Sean e Kamal aproximarem-se dele?.

programme.title: The Dog Academy T2 - Ep. 2

It aims to connect people, cultures and societies across the East and the West. The program features dynamic designs, fast pace and rich visuals to keep viewers engaged. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Vingança
programme.desc: O campeão de kickboxing Eric Sloane aceita participar numa luta ilegal de Muay Thai na Tailândia mas morre às mãos do implacável Tong Po. Kurt, o seu irmão mais novo, jura vingá-lo e é treinado por Durand para conseguir sobreviver à batalha final contra o mortífero lutador.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth casa com um brilhante cientista e muda-se para a luxuosa casa dele, onde há apenas um quarto em que é impedida de entrar. Quando ela decide investigar a razão, percebe que o marido pode não ser quem ela pensa.

programme.title: Mark Felt - O Homem Que Derrubou A Casa Branca
programme.desc: Esta é a história do anónimo mais famoso da história americana: Mark Felt, o vice-presidente do FBI que foi o “Garganta Funda”, o denunciante secreto que ajudou os jornalistas Bob Woodward e Carl Bernstein a revelarem o escândalo Watergate em 1972.

programme.title: Bikes
programme.desc: Spokesville é a terra das bicicletas. Speedy é um velocípede de montanha e está pronto para ser o líder quando o motor a gasolina chega para incomodar toda a cidade. Agora, terá de fazer de tudo para enfrentar a nova realidade e manter a cidade limpa.

programme.title: Snow - A Pedra Dos Desejos
programme.desc: O raro dom de estar constantemente a arranjar sarilhos é um traço que une estes nossos amigos! Que mais poderíamos esperar de gémeos criados entre trolls? Mas Kiara e Kai estão agora mais crescidos e o nível de confusão aumenta – desta vez, eles vão mesmo precisar da ajuda de todos.

programme.title: Snow - Os Domínios Do Espelho
programme.desc: Certo dia o Rei Harald, que odeia magia, decide isolar todos os Mágicos nos Domínios do Espelho. Desta forma, a última esperança para o Universo da Magia, é Kiara. Ela terá de descobrir os seus verdadeiros poderes e salvar a sua família, todos os mágicos e a própria magia!

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: Após um espetáculo de ilusionismo em Londres, Sondra, uma estudante norte-americana de jornalismo, apercebe-se que consegue ouvir a voz de um reporter já falecido, que a vai conduzir na investigação da identidade de um assassino, que poderá ser o aristocrata por quem ela se apaixonou.

programme.title: Asiaticos Doidos E Ricos
programme.desc: Rachel é uma professora sino-americana que viaja até Singapura com o namorado Nick e fica chocada ao perceber que a família dele é uma das mais ricas e influentes do país.

programme.title: Big Game Instinto Caçador
programme.desc: Nas florestas da Finlândia, um jovem de 13 anos descobre uma cápsula de salvação do Air Force One. O homem ferido à sua frente é o Presidente dos EUA, e há um grupo de terroristas a caminho para tentar raptá-lo. Agora vão ter de agir em equipa para sobreviver à noite mais perigosa das suas vidas.

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Retaliação
programme.desc: Um ano após os acontecimentos de “Kickboxer - A Vingança”, Kurt Sloan jura nunca voltar à Tailândia. Mas acaba por ser forçado a regressar ao ser dopado e atirado para uma prisão. Para recuperar a liberdade, terá de enfrentar Mongkut, um verdadeiro gigante de 200kg e mais de dois metros de altura.

programme.title: O Nome do Medo
programme.desc: Quando três amigos da faculdade encontram as origens horríveis do Bye Bye Man, descobrem que há apenas uma maneira de evitar a sua maldição: não pensar nele, não dizer o seu nome. Mas quando ele entra nos nossos pensamentos, assume o controle. Existirá alguma maneira de sobreviver ao seu poder?

programme.title: Lansky
programme.desc: Ao mesmo tempo que Meyer Lansky é investigado uma última vez pelo FBI, que suspeita que ele tenha escondido milhões de dólares ao longo de várias décadas, o gangster reformado conta a um jornalista toda a verdade sobre a sua vida de líder de organizações criminosas.

programme.title: Amesterdão
programme.desc: Na década de 1930, três amigos testemunham um crime, são acusados de o terem praticado acabam por desvendar uma das conspirações mais inacreditáveis da historia dos EUA.

programme.title: A Morte Fica-vos Tão Bem
programme.desc: Há 14 anos, Madeline seduziu Ernest, que estava noivo de Helen, e casou com ele. Agora ele está alcoólico e deprimido e junta-se à antiga namorada para matar Madeline. Só que ela tomou um elixir da juventude que lhe dá vida eterna, por isso matá-la não será suficiente.

programme.title: Rogue Warfare: A Arte Da Guerra
programme.desc: Um grupo de combate elite junta os melhores militares dos exércitos norte-americano, russo, britânico, chinês e francês para enfrentar uma rede terrorista absolutamente letal.

programme.title: Rogue Warfare: A Caçada
programme.desc: Cumprindo ordens diretas do Presidente dos EUA, uma equipa de soldados de elite tem de atravessar as linhas do inimigo para libertar o seu líder, que foi capturado por terroristas.

programme.title: Rogue Warfare: Fim De Uma Nação
programme.desc: Uma terrível organização terrorista coordena um ataque mortífero que vai devastar o mundo nas próximas 36 horas. Só uma equipa de elite que une os melhores militares de várias nações pode evitar o desastre.

programme.title: Um Dia
programme.desc: Depois de terem passado, na universidade, o dia da formatura juntos – 15 de Julho de 1988 – Emma Morley e Dexter Mayhew começam uma amizade que irá durar a vida inteira, e que, entre risos e lágrimas, vamos acompanhar, anualmente, sempre no mesmo dia.

programme.title: O Chacal
programme.desc: Quando um impiedoso assassino conhecido como Chacal é contratado para eliminar um elemento importante do governo dos EUA, o diretor-adjunto do FBI vai resgatar à prisão um atirador do IRA para juntos deterem o misterioso mercenário antes que ele consiga levar a cabo a sua mortífera missão.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: O Homem Que Sabia Demais
programme.desc: Ben McKenna e Jo Conway são um casal americano de férias em Marrocos, que testemunham um crime e acabam por ser puxados para uma intriga internacional quando o seu o filho é raptado para os silenciar.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: Noite Violenta
programme.desc: Quando uma equipa de mercenários invade a mansão de uma família rica na véspera de Natal, tornando reféns os seus membros, o grupo não está preparado para um combatente surpresa: o Pai Natal está lá em casa e prepara-se para mostrar que Nicolau não é santo nenhum.

programme.title: Crimson Peak - A Colina Vermelha
programme.desc: Quando o seu coração é roubado por um estranho sedutor, uma jovem é levada para uma casa no topo de uma colina de argila vermelha: um lugar repleto de segredos que a assombrarão para sempre. Entre o desejo e a escuridão, o mistério e a loucura, encontra-se a verdade por detrás de Crimson Peak.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2003 - A Gershwin Night
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20, 000-seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world. In 2003, Seiji Ozawa and the Berliner Philharmoniker perform works by George Gershwin with the jazz pianist Marcus Roberts and his Trio as special guests.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 21
programme.desc: From the Rammenau Castle, the Gewandhaus-Quartett presents Mozart's String Quartet No. 21 in D major, K. 575. Nicknamed The Violet, this piece was composed in 1789 and is the first of the Prussian Quartets, a series of plays written for Friedrich Wilhelm II, King of Prussia and amateur cellist, in a style similar to Joseph Haydn's quartets.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Debussy, Chopin and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Josquin in Spain - Missa Hercules Dux Ferrariæ
programme.desc: Spanish and Flemish musical chapels characterized the music practice at the courts of Charles V and Philip II. But how would Josquin sound in the Spanish tradition, with singers doubled by wind instruments? And how would Josquin sound alongside music by his admirer Guerrero?

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Chopin, Brahms and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1996: Saint Petersburg
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Bizet - Symphony in C
programme.desc: Enjoy a sparkling performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s famous Piano Concerto No. 1, by the incredible piano virtuoso Russian Daniil Trifonov, with Kent Nagano conducting the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, to prove once more how majestic and incredible classical music can be when it’s done right! The concert opens with the famous Air from Bach's Orchestral Suite No. 3.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 4
programme.desc: Discover the soloist Heidrun Holtmann as she performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 1, KV 37 and Piano Concerto No. 4, KV 41, accompanied by the Orchestra della Radiotelevisione della Svizzera. Conducted by Marc Andreae, the performance took place at the historic Teatro Bibiena in Mantua.

programme.title: Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich, violinist Tedi Papavrami and cellist Mischa Maisky perform Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Piano works by Mendelssohn
programme.desc: The Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (*1975) is considered one of today’s leading interpreters of Felix Mendelssohn’s piano repertoire. Prosseda’s discovery of unknown Mendelssohn compositions made the headlines throughout Europe and led to several releases on the celebrated Decca label.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: 60th Anniversary
programme.desc: In 1996, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra celebrated its 60th anniversary with a gala led by maestros Zubin Mehta and Daniel Barenboim. This musical event features world-renowned soloists, including veteran violinist Isaac Stern, up-and-coming musicians Maxim Vengerov and Gil Shaham, as well as Pinchas Zukerman, Shlomo Mintz, and Itzhak Perlman. The evening begins with a moving speech about the early days of the orchestra.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.desc: Uma história de amor envolvendo um homem, um adolescente e uma criança. Ela é Estrellita uma linda e sensual mulher, capaz de exercer um fascínio no sexo oposto e em diferentes faixas etárias. programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 83
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 - Alune Wade
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Long Tall Dex: Dexter Gordon Live in '63 And '64
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 And '64 features three concerts filmed in 1963 and 1964 in Holland, Switzerland and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Filmed while Dexter was living in Europe, these shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano) and jazz classics ‘Blues Walk’, ‘A Night In Tunisia’, ‘Body And Soul’ and others.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz à Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Artvark Saxophone Quartet And Ntjam Rosie: Homelands
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with The NPG and Questlove
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Kinda Dukish And Rockin' in Rhythm
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Here's that rainy day
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Song for my father
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Paradox Live: Vein ft. Greg Osby
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Christine Kamau
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: B.B. King Orchestra - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1979, legendary American blues guitarist B.B. King gave an unforgettable performance for the audience in The Hague.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: Wee Dot
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Ellington Medley
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Sluijs And Vermeulen
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs and pianist Erik Vermeulen both had a classical training.

programme.title: Identities. The Recording
programme.desc: ‘Identities: The Recording’ is a concert film about the recording of composer, arranger, saxophonist and band leader Karlis Vanags’s album 'Identities' with the Latvian Radio Big Band. The film shows all the album tracks as well as behind-the-scenes footage. 'Identities', which was recorded directly to analog tape without editing or overdubbing, won the Latvian Music Award for Best Latvian Jazz Album in 2020.

programme.title: Ricardo Herz Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: After You've Gone
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Song for Abdullah
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: We Are Birds - La Ciotat
programme.desc: Nordic afro jazz project 'We Are Birds' saw the light between Finland and Africa, during a 2010 jam session in which Finnish jazz pianist Tuomas A. Turunen met African drummer-percussionist and urban griot Dimitri Reverchon. The two composers set their mind to exploring this hybrid genre, and found their perfect complement in bassist Emmanuel Soulignac, who brought his pop influences to the table.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Oran - Open Arms
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Skylark
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Bill Evans - Maison de la Radio
programme.desc: Bill Evans is considered one of the greatest jazz pianists all time and is known for interpreting the jazz repertoire using impressionistic harmonies. In 1958, Evans first played in Miles Davis’s sextet recording the modal jazz album “Kind of Blue”, which is now considered one of the best jazz albums of all time. After leaving the ensemble, Evans formed several trios.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century.

programme.title: Mn'JAM Experiment: Live with a Boom
programme.desc: Imagine that visual arts and music are no longer two separate fields; that musicians no longer focus on their instruments only, but also on the visuals of their performance. Such is the premise of Mn'JAM Experiment!

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: La Waltz 2, 3 and More
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: Portrait: Urgent Detergent
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: São Paulo Samba
programme.desc: An exceptional concert from Brazil: the Orquestra Sinfônica do Estado de São Paulo proves its position as the most important orchestra in Latin America. Conducted by charismatic Maestro John Neschling since 1997, the orchestra is defined by its emblematic interpretations of Latin American music.
